12GHz bandstop FSS: periodic metal cross array on dielectric substrate. Excited by a plane wave at incidence theta: normal incidence simulates a quarter unit cell with symmetry boundaries, oblique incidence one unit cell with periodic (Bloch) boundaries. Compare with 

Tidy3D example

Run in Lumi Colab

import os
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

import gdsfactory as gf
from gdsfactory.technology import LogicalLayer, LayerLevel, LayerStack
import luminescent as lumi

# simulation folder
path = os.path.join("runs", "FSS")

# dims [mm]
# length units are arbitrary so long as they're consistent
P = 15  # periodicity
L = 9.4  # length of cross
W = 2.0  # width of cross stub
h_sub = 2.2  # substrate thickness
h_metal = 0.1  # metal thickness

# frequencies [GHz]
# spectrum computed from single FDTD run. more frequencies slightly increases runtime
frequency = 12
bandwidth = 4
nfs = 81
frequencies = np.linspace(frequency - bandwidth / 2, frequency + bandwidth / 2, nfs)

c0 = 300  # speed of light [mm GHz]

# incidence angle [degrees] from z in xz plane. E along y (TE)
theta = 0

def setup(path, frequency, frequencies, P, L, W, h_sub, h_metal, theta):
    # simulation parameters
    nres = 12
    dx = W / 16  # desired resolution near metal
    shutoff = 1e-3
    tmax = 1000  # max time [periods]
    PML_decay = 0.0001  # x y z
    courant = 0.9
    subpixel_smoothing = 1
    shot_every = 2.5  # movie [periods]
    views = [lumi.view("Ex",x=0, z=h_metal / 2)]

    # normal incidence: quarter unit cell [0, P/2]² with symmetry walls (E along y: PEC on x, PMC on y)
    # oblique incidence: one full unit cell, periodic in x y. Bloch wavevector sets incidence angle (exact at center frequency)
    sym = theta == 0
    if sym:
        boundaries = ["PEC", "PMC", "PML"]
        k_bloch = None
    else:
        boundaries = ["periodic", "periodic", "PML"]
        k_bloch = lumi.bloch_wavevector(theta, 0, dim=3, f=frequency, c0=c0)

    # margins
    # air gap keeps evanescent resonant field from coupling to PML
    gap = 30.0
    source_offset = 2.0

    # vertical dims
    z_o1 = h_metal + gap
    z_o2 = -h_sub - gap
    zmin = z_o2
    zmax = z_o1 + source_offset

    # materials
    # refine mesh in substrate and metal: n sets mesh density relative to vacuum
    materials = {
        "air": lumi.material(1),
        "sub": lumi.material(epsilon=2.5),
        "PEC": lumi.PEC_material(dx=dx),
    }
    background = "air"

    # layers
    METAL = 1, 0
    SUB = 2, 0
    layer_stack = LayerStack(
        layers={
            "metal": LayerLevel(
                layer=LogicalLayer(layer=METAL),
                thickness=h_metal,
                zmin=0,
                material="PEC",
                mesh_order=1,
            ),
            "sub": LayerLevel(
                layer=LogicalLayer(layer=SUB),
                thickness=h_sub,
                zmin=-h_sub,
                material="sub",
                mesh_order=2,
            ),
        }
    )

    # make component in gdsfactory. alternatively can import .gds into gdsfactory
    # cross unit cell centered at origin, clipped to quarter cell x, y >= 0 under symmetry
    lo = 0 if sym else -1

    def rect(a, b):
        return [(lo * a, lo * b), (a, lo * b), (a, b), (lo * a, b)]

    c = gf.Component()
    c.add_polygon(rect(W / 2, L / 2), layer=METAL)
    c.add_polygon(rect(L / 2, W / 2), layer=METAL)
    c.add_polygon(rect(P / 2, P / 2), layer=SUB)
    c.plot()

    bbox = c.bbox_np().tolist()
    bbox[0].append(zmin)
    bbox[1].append(zmax)

    # sources, monitors
    # plane wave on face frame spanning the cell. E along y, H along x
    # wave admittance in air: Hx/Ey = cos(theta) in magnitude (sign fixed automatically)
    frames = [lumi.face("plane_wave", modes=[[{"Ex": 1, "Hy": np.cos(np.deg2rad(theta))}]])]

    # dim: outward normal axis. source injects into cell, monitors record in (-) and out (+) waves
    sources = [
        lumi.source(
            "o1", z_o1 + source_offset, dim=3,
            frame="plane_wave",
            f=frequency,
            bandwidth=max(max(frequencies) - min(frequencies), frequency / 8),
        )
    ]

    monitors = [
        lumi.monitor("o1", z_o1, dim=3, frame="plane_wave"),
        lumi.monitor("o2", z_o2, dim=-3, frame="plane_wave"),
    ]

    # writes .obj mesh files from gdsfactory component
    lumi.mesh(path, c, layer_stack, materials, zmin, zmax)

    # writes setup file
    lumi.setup(
        path=path,
        f=frequency,
        fs=frequencies,
        c0=c0,
        materials=materials,
        background=background,
        boundaries=boundaries,
        # k_bloch=k_bloch,
        bbox=bbox,
        #
        frames=frames,
        sources=sources,
        monitors=monitors,
        #
        nres=nres,
        courant=courant,
        PML_decay=PML_decay,
        subpixel_smoothing=subpixel_smoothing,
        # 
        views=views,
        shot_every=shot_every,
        tmax=tmax,
        shutoff=shutoff,
    )


setup(path, frequency, frequencies, P, L, W, h_sub, h_metal, theta)
lumi.solve(path)
lumi.movie(path)

sol = lumi.load(path)
o1 = sol["monitors"]["o1"]
o2 = sol["monitors"]["o2"]

# + denotes outgoing mode (wrt port monitor outward normal), - incoming
S21 = o2["modes"][0]["+"] / o1["modes"][0]["-"]
S11 = o1["modes"][0]["+"] / o1["modes"][0]["-"]

plt.figure()
plt.plot(frequencies, 10 * np.log10(np.abs(S21)**2), label="S21")
plt.plot(frequencies, 10 * np.log10(np.abs(S11)**2), label="S11")
plt.xlabel("f [GHz]")
plt.ylabel("power [dB]")
plt.legend()
plt.show()

bandwidth = 0.1
nwls = 11
wavelengths = np.linspace(wavelength - bandwidth / 2, wavelength + bandwidth / 2, nwls)

# Gaussian fiber mode dimensions [um]
D_beam = 10.4  # mode field diameter, SMF-28
Dlim = 1.5 * D_beam  # beam frame width

    boundaries = ["PML", ["PEC", "PML"], "PML"]
    nres = 10
    shutoff = 1e-4
    tmax = 1000  # max time [periods]
    PML_decay = [0.001, 0.1, 0.001]
    shot_every = 10

    l_wg = 2
    margin = 1.

    source_offset = .25
    zmargin = 1
    zmin =  - zmargin
    fiber_offset=zmargin+source_offset
    zmax = h_core + fiber_offset
    z_port = zmax - source_offset

    nclad = 1.444
    materials = {
        "Si": lumi.material(3.478),
        "SiO2": lumi.material(nclad),
    }
    background = "SiO2"

    WG = (1, 0)
    SLAB = (2, 0)
    BBOX = (3, 0)
    layer_stack = LayerStack(
        layers={
            "core": LayerLevel(
                layer=LogicalLayer(layer=WG),
                thickness=h_core,
                zmin=0,
                material="Si",
                mesh_order=200,
            ),
            "slab": LayerLevel(
                layer=LogicalLayer(layer=SLAB),
                thickness=h_slab,
                zmin=0,
                material="Si",
                mesh_order=100,
            ),
        }
    )

    c = gf.Component()
    gc = c << gf.components.grating_coupler_elliptical_uniform(
        n_periods=n_periods,
        period=period,
        fill_factor=fill_factor,
        taper_length=taper_length,
        taper_angle=taper_angle,
        wavelength=wavelength,
        fiber_angle=fiber_angle,
        nclad=nclad,
        layer_slab=SLAB,
        cross_section=gf.cross_section.cross_section(width=w_wg, layer=WG),
    )
    wg = c << gf.components.straight(
        length=l_wg,
        cross_section=gf.cross_section.cross_section(width=w_wg, layer=WG),
    )
    wg.connect("o2", gc.ports["o1"])
    # c << gf.components.bbox(component=c, layer=BBOX, top=margin, bottom=margin)
    x_fiber = gc.ports["o2"].x + np.sin(np.deg2rad(fiber_angle)) * fiber_offset
    c << gf.components.bbox(  # enclose fiber frame
        component=c,
        layer=BBOX,
        top=margin,
        bottom=margin,
        right=max(0, x_fiber + Dlim / 2 - gc.xmax),
    )
    full_bbox = c.bbox_np().tolist()

    clipper = gf.Component()
    clipper_ref = clipper << gf.components.rectangle(
        size=(full_bbox[1][0] - full_bbox[0][0], full_bbox[1][1]),
        layer=WG,
    )

    half_component = gf.Component()
    clipper_ref.movex(full_bbox[0][0])
    for layer in (WG, SLAB, BBOX):
        clipped = gf.boolean(
            c,
            clipper,
            operation="and",
            layer=layer,
            layer1=layer,
            layer2=WG,
        )
        half_component << clipped
    half_component.add_port("wg", port=wg.ports["o1"])
    half_component.flatten()
    c = half_component
    c.plot()

    bbox = c.bbox_np().tolist()
    bbox[0][1] = 0
    bbox[0].append(zmin)
    bbox[1].append(zmax)

# sources, monitors
    frames = [
        lumi.plane_frame(
            "wg",
            start=[-w_wg / 2 - margin, -zmargin],
            stop=[0, h_core + zmargin],
            boundaries=[("PML", "PEC"), "PML"],
            wls_mode_solver=[wavelength],
        ),
        lumi.plane_frame(
            "fiber",
            modes=[
                [
                    lumi.gaussian_mode(
                        D_beam,
                        nclad,
                        dx=wavelength / nclad / nres,
                        theta=np.deg2rad(fiber_angle),
                        wl=wavelength,
                        half="y+",
                        Dlim=Dlim,
                    )
                ]
            ],
            start=[-Dlim / 2, 0],
            stop=[Dlim / 2, Dlim / 2],
        ),
    ]

    fiber_origin = [
        gc.ports["o2"].center[0] + np.sin(np.deg2rad(fiber_angle)) * fiber_offset,
        0,
        z_port,
    ]
    fiber_basis = [[1, 0, 0], [0, 1, 0], [0, 0, 1]]
    sources = [
        lumi.source(
            "fiber",
            fiber_origin,
            fiber_basis,
            frame="fiber",
            wl=wavelength,
            bandwidth=max(max(wavelengths) - min(wavelengths), wavelength / 8),
        )
    ]
    monitors = [
        lumi.gf_monitor("wg", c, layer_stack, frame="wg"),
        lumi.monitor("fiber", fiber_origin, fiber_basis, frame="fiber"),
    ]

    views = [lumi.view("Ey", y=0, z=h_slab+h_teeth / 2)]
    lumi.mesh(path, c, layer_stack, materials, zmin, zmax)
    lumi.setup(
        path=path,

# optimized: n_periods=16, period=0.635, fill_factor=0.5, h_slab=0.12 -> efficiency 0.43 at 1.55 um
params = [n_periods, period, fill_factor, taper_length, taper_angle]
path = os.path.join("runs", "GC")

plt.plot(wavelengths, S, "o-")

import os
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

import gdsfactory as gf
from gdsfactory.technology import LogicalLayer, LayerLevel, LayerStack
import luminescent as lumi
from scipy.spatial import ConvexHull

path = os.path.join("runs", "GC_invd")

wl = 1.55
bandwidth = 0.01
nwls = 3
wls = np.linspace(wl - bandwidth / 2, wl + bandwidth / 2, nwls)

# simulation parameters
nres = 10
boundaries = ["PML", ["PEC", "PML"], "PML"]
# PML_decay = [0.01, 0.3, 0.01]
PML_decay = [0.001, 0.1, 0.001]
courant = 0.95
# shutoff=.001
shutoff=None

# horizontal dimensions
D = 10.4  # mode field diameter, SMF-28
R = 1.5 * D/2  # beam frame half width
# flare = 25  # waveguide flare full angle (deg)
# W = 3 * D
# L = W
# L = W/2/np.tan(flare/2/180*np.pi)
# elliptical grating coupler whose outline is the design contour
n_periods = 16
period = 0.635
fill_factor = 0.5
taper_length = 15.0
taper_angle = 40.0
w_wg = 0.5
# l_wg =1
l_wg = 2
l_flare = .5

# margin = .5
margin = 1
# nox=1.44
nox = 1.444
# vertical dimensions
# theta = 7 * np.pi / 180 # beam angle
theta = 6.9 * np.pi / 180  # beam angle
h_wg = 0.22
# h_etch = 0.08
h_etch = 0.10
h_slab = h_wg-h_etch
# h_box = 2.0  # buried oxide
h_box = (1 + .5) *wl / (2 * nox * np.cos( theta))
# h_sub = 0.3  # substrate thickness in domain

# zmargin = .6
zmargin = 1
# port_offset = 0.3
port_offset = zmargin
# source_offset = 0.3
source_offset = 0.25
z_port = h_wg + port_offset

# zmin = -h_box - h_sub
# zmin = -h_box
zmin = -zmargin
zmax = h_wg + port_offset + source_offset

# movie parameters
shot_every = 10

views = [
    lumi.view("Ey", y=0, z=h_slab+h_etch/2,mirrors = ["y-"]),
]

# materials
core = "Si"
clad = "SiO2"
materials = {
    # "Si": lumi.material(3.45),
    # "SiO2": lumi.material(1.44),
    "Si": lumi.material(3.478),
    "SiO2": lumi.material(nox),
}

n_core = materials[core]["n"]
n_clad = materials[clad]["n"]
lambda_core = wl / n_core
lambda_clad = wl / n_clad
dx = lambda_core / nres

background = clad
materials["design"] = lumi.placeholder_material(n_core)

# layer stack. lower mesh order layers override higher mesh order layers.
WG = (1, 0)
CLAD = (2, 0)
SLAB = (102, 0)
DESIGN = (1001, 0)
CONTOUR=(1002,0)

layers = {
    "design": LayerLevel(
        layer=LogicalLayer(layer=DESIGN),
        zmin=h_slab,
        thickness=h_etch,
        material="design",
        mesh_order=1,
    ),
    "rib": LayerLevel(
        # layer=LogicalLayer(layer=SLAB),
        layer=LogicalLayer(layer=CONTOUR),
        zmin=h_slab,
        thickness=h_etch,
        material=core,
        mesh_order=101,
    ),
    "slab": LayerLevel(
        layer=LogicalLayer(layer=SLAB),
        zmin=0,
        thickness=h_slab,
        material=core,
        mesh_order=102,
    ),
    "core": LayerLevel(
        layer=LogicalLayer(layer=WG),
        zmin=0,
        thickness=h_wg,
        material=core,
        mesh_order=200,
    ),
    # "substrate": LayerLevel(
    #     layer=LogicalLayer(layer=CLAD),
    #     zmin=zmin,
    #     thickness=h_sub,
    #     material=core,
    #     mesh_order=300,
    # ),
}
layer_stack = LayerStack(layers=layers)

optimizer = lumi.optimizer(
    stoploss=0.1,
    lowloss=0.5,
    # iters=20,
    iters=40,
    contrast=0,
    momentum=0.7,
)
targets = [
    lumi.target(src="o2@0-", dst="o1@0+", target=1, weight=1 / nwls, wl=wl)
    for wl in wls
]
lmin=.1

# Build the gdsfactory component to be optimized (upper half, mirrored about y=0).
# design contour: outline of elliptical grating coupler, grating center at x=0 under beam
gc = gf.components.grating_coupler_elliptical_uniform(
    n_periods=n_periods,
    period=period,
    fill_factor=fill_factor,
    taper_length=taper_length,
    taper_angle=taper_angle,
    wavelength=wl,
    fiber_angle=np.degrees(theta),
    nclad=nox,
    # layer_slab=None,
    layer_slab=SLAB,
    cross_section=gf.cross_section.cross_section(width=w_wg, layer=WG),
)
q = np.vstack([np.array(p) for ps in gc.get_polygons_points(layers=[WG]).values() for p in ps])
q = q[ConvexHull(q).vertices] - [gc.ports["o2"].x, 0]
p = np.c_[q[:, 0], np.maximum(q[:, 1], 0)]  # upper half
x_design, L, W = p[:, 0].min(), np.ptp(p[:, 0]), 2 * p[:, 1].max()

# x_design = -L + R
# x_flare = ox_design - l_flare
# x_wg = x_flare - l_wg

c = gf.Component()
for layer in (DESIGN, ):
    rect = c << gf.components.rectangle(size=(L, W / 2), layer=layer)
    rect.movex(x_design)

# w_flare = w_wg / 2 + l_flare * np.tan(np.radians(flare / 2))
x_wg=x_design-l_wg
# p=[(x_design,0),(x_design,w_wg/2),(x_design+L,W/2),(x_design+L,0)]
c.add_polygon([(x_wg, 0), (x_wg, w_wg / 2), (x_design, w_wg / 2), (x_design,0)], layer=WG)
c.add_polygon(p, layer=CONTOUR)
c.add_polygon(p, layer=SLAB)
for ps in gc.get_polygons_points(layers=[SLAB]).values():  # slab overhang, as in GC
    for s in ps:
        s = np.array(s) - [gc.ports["o2"].x, 0]
        c.add_polygon(np.c_[s[:, 0], np.maximum(s[:, 1], 0)], layer=SLAB)

# c << gf.components.bbox(component=c, layer=CLAD, top=margin, right=margin)
# c << gf.components.bbox(  # also enclose beam frame
#     component=c,
#     layer=CLAD,
#     top=max(margin, R + margin - W / 2),
#     right=max(margin, R + margin - x_design - L),
# )
x_fiber = np.sin(theta) * (port_offset + source_offset)
c << gf.components.bbox(  # enclose beam frame, as in GC
    component=c,
    layer=CLAD,
    top=margin,
    right=max(0, x_fiber + R - c.xmax),
)

c.add_port("o1", center=(x_wg, 0), width=w_wg / 2, orientation=180, layer=WG)


c.plot()



frames = [
    lumi.plane_frame(
        "wg",
        start=[-w_wg / 2 - margin, -zmargin],
        stop=[0, h_wg+zmargin],
        boundaries=[("PML", "PEC"), "PML"],
        wls_mode_solver=[wl],
    ),
    lumi.plane_frame(
        "beam",
        modes=[
            [
                lumi.gaussian_mode(
                    D,
                    n_clad,
                    dx=dx,
                    theta=theta,
                    wl=wl,
                    half="y+",
                    Dlim=2*R,
                )
            ]
        ],
        start=[-R, 0],
        stop=[R, R],
    ),
]

# origin = [
#     np.sin(theta) * (source_offset + port_offset),
#     0,
#     h_wg + port_offset + source_offset,
# ]
origin = [x_fiber, 0, h_wg + port_offset]  # source and beam monitor at same point, as in GC
basis = [[1, 0, 0], [0, 1, 0], [0, 0, 1]]
sources = [
    lumi.source(
        "o2",
        origin,
        basis,
        wl=wl,
        bandwidth=max(max(wls) - min(wls), wl / 8),
        frame="beam",
    )
]

# origin = [np.sin(theta) * (port_offset), 0, h_wg + port_offset]
monitors = [
    lumi.gf_monitor("o1", c, layer_stack, frame="wg"),
    lumi.monitor("o2", origin, basis, frame="beam"),
]


designs = [
    lumi.design(
        name="design",
        lmin =lmin,
        layer=DESIGN,
        contour_layer=CONTOUR,
        fill_material=core,
        void_material=clad,
        component=c,
        layer_stack=layer_stack,
        materials=materials,
        repdims=[3],
        anchordims=[],
    )
]

tmax =     1./ wl    * (
        (port_offset + source_offset + 2 * h_box) / np.cos(theta) * n_clad
        + (L + W / 2 + R + l_wg) * n_core
    )    + sources[0]["duration"]

bbox = c.bbox_np().tolist()
bbox[0].append(zmin)
bbox[1].append(zmax)

lumi.mesh(path, c, layer_stack, materials, zmin, zmax)
lumi.setup(
    path=path,
    wl=wl,
    wls=wls,
    frames=frames,
    monitors=monitors,
    sources=sources,
    boundaries=boundaries,
    bbox=bbox,
    materials=materials,
    background=background,
    nres=nres,
    tmax=tmax,
    PML_decay=PML_decay,
    courant=courant,
    shutoff=shutoff,
    shot_every=shot_every,
    views=views,
    designs=designs,
    targets=targets,

bend_type = "euler"

nwls = 11
wavelengths = np.linspace(wavelength - bandwidth / 2, wavelength + bandwidth / 2, nwls)

    # simulation parameters
    nres = 6
    subpixel_smoothing = 1
    shutoff = 1e-3
    tmax = 100
    PML_decay = [0.001, 0.001, 0.1]  # x y z

    source_offset = 1

    # vertical dims
    zmargin = 0.8
    zmin = -h_wg / 2 - zmargin
    zmax = h_wg / 2 + zmargin

    # materials

    clad = "SiO2"
    materials = {
        "Si": lumi.material(3.5),
        "SiO2": lumi.material(1.5),
    }
    background = clad

    CLAD = 2, 0

                    mesh_order=1,

            "o1", c, layer_stack,
            frame="wg_mode",

            frame="wg_mode",

def bend_euler_s45(cross_section="strip"):

    c = gf.Component()
    b = gf.components.bend_euler(angle=45, cross_section=cross_section)
    b1 = c << b
    b2 = c << b
    b2.connect("o1", b1.ports["o2"], mirror=True)
    c.add_port("o1", port=b1.ports["o1"])
    c.add_port("o2", port=b2.ports["o2"])
    c.flatten()

def classify(path, frame="mm", wl=1.55):
    """per solved mode: TE fraction (lateral E energy) and lateral parity of the dominant E (+1 even, -1 odd)"""
    out = []
    for i in range(nmodes_mm):
        d = np.load(os.path.join(path, "modes", frame, str(wl), f"{i}.npz"))

        a = ex if te > 0.5 else ey
        parity = np.real(np.vdot(a, a[::-1, :])) / np.real(np.vdot(a, a))
        out.append((te, parity))
    return out

    return te0, te1

def resonance(wls_nm, T):
    """lowest-wavelength resonance of normalized T: (λ0, FWHM at half dip depth); deeper dip of a doublet"""
    x = np.arange(wls_nm[0], wls_nm[-1], 0.02)
    y = CubicSpline(wls_nm, T)(x)
    dips = [k for k in range(1, len(y) - 1) if y[k] < y[k - 1] and y[k] <= y[k + 1] and y[k] < 0.5]

    def fwhm(k):
        win = abs(x - x[k]) < 3  # local max within ±3 nm (FSR ≈ 7.5 nm)
        half = (y[win].max() + y[k]) / 2
        l = k
        while y[l] < half:
            l -= 1
        r = k
        while y[r] < half:
            r += 1
        # linear interpolation of the half-level crossings
        xl = x[l] + (half - y[l]) / (y[l + 1] - y[l]) * (x[l + 1] - x[l])
        xr = x[r - 1] + (half - y[r - 1]) / (y[r] - y[r - 1]) * (x[r] - x[r - 1])
        return xr - xl

    pair = [d for d in dips if x[d] - x[dips[0]] < 2]  # doublet halves lie within 2 nm
    k = min(pair, key=lambda d: y[d])
    return x[k], fwhm(k)

Draw the device as a gdsfactory component (or import a .gds) with ports, plus a LayerStack assigning thickness and material per layer.

Define materials, frames, sources and monitors.

lumi.mesh(path, c, layer_stack, materials, zmin, zmax) writes 3D meshes into simulation folder path.

lumi.setup(path, ...) writes the simulation problem and solves port modes.

lumi.solve(path) runs FDTD. Runs on Lumi Colab server.

lumi.movie(path) shows the field movie; sol = lumi.load(path) loads results.

See 

bend for a minimal example.

Length units are arbitrary but must be consistent: eg um for photonics, mm for RF.

Photonics: wl (center) and wls (result wavelengths) in length units.

RF: f and fs with c0, speed of light in your units, eg c0=300 for mm and GHz.

Results are arrays over wls or fs, in the order given.

Times (tmax, shot_every, t0) are in periods of the center frequency.

One run computes the whole spectrum; more wavelengths add little runtime.

nres: grid points per wavelength in material. 6 is a good start for photonics. Convergence typically <1% after nres=8

Keep nres low! Due to subpixel smoothing tensors Lumi can achieve comparable accuracy at lower nres. Runtime scales O(N^4) and domain size O(N^3). High nres is useless and will breach free tier cell limit.

Grid adapts to each material’s n; subpixel_smoothing averages material boundaries for accuracy; PEC boundaries use conformal (Yu–Mittra) edge weighting.

Check convergence by increasing nres until results stop changing.

Use symmetry to halve the domain: PMC or PEC boundary on one side, eg ("PMC", "PML").

lumi.material(n) or lumi.material(epsilon=...): relative permittivity, scalar or 3x3 tensor for anisotropic materials.

Also mu, sigma (relative units: multiply S/m by 377 * (characteristic wavelength in m)), chi2, chi3, dispersion: list of lumi.lorentzian, lumi.drude or lumi.gain terms (Meep convention).

n also sets mesh density relative to vacuum, default sqrt(epsilon * mu). Raise it, or set dx (max grid spacing in geometry units), to refine the grid in a material, eg thin metals. dx only refines, never coarsens.

lumi.PEC_material(n): perfect conductor for metals.

lumi.placeholder_material(n): meshed but no physical properties, eg design regions.

materials is a dict of name to material; LayerStack layers and background refer to these names.

Coordinate frame with sampling regions or points, reusable by any number of sources and monitors at different positions via frame="name". Pass all frames to setup(frames=...).

Local coordinates: origin at the source or monitor origin, axes from its basis. mirrored=True flips local x, eg for a port on the opposite side of a symmetric device.

Types and results:

plane_frame: port cross section with solved modes. Results modes, flux, power. Sources need one.

points_frame: fields at points, or sensor="voltage" / "current" integrals for RF.

box_frame: fields in a sampled volume.

cage_frame: closed box surface. Flux per face, power, far field.

spherical_frame: sphere of radius r. Flux, power, far field if closed.

Results are frequency domain at wls or fs by default; time_domain=True records time signals instead.

Source and monitor names match gdsfactory port names, eg "o1". gf_source and gf_monitor place them at ports.

General constructors source monitor

Port basis rows: local x, local y, outward normal. Sources inject bidirectional.

Monitor results: sol["monitors"][name]["modes"][mode number]["+" or "-"], where "+" is outgoing (along normal), "-" incoming.

S-parameters are ratios of mode amplitudes, egS21 = sol["monitors"]["o2"]["modes"][0]["+"] / sol["monitors"]["o1"]["modes"][0]["-"]
S11 = sol["monitors"]["o1"]["modes"][0]["+"] / sol["monitors"]["o1"]["modes"][0]["-"]

Inverse design targets use "port@mode±", eg lumi.target("o1@0-", "o2@0+", 1).

Optimizes the material layout in design regions to meet S-parameter targets. Max tier only. See 

GC_invd.

D = 20  # lens diameter [um]
f = 20  # focal length [um]

# library transmission normalized to max amplitude
lib = t * np.abs(S21) / np.abs(S21).max()

PILLAR = 1, 0

l_stub = c0 / frequency * v_rel / 4
l_feed = l_stub


def setup(path, frequency, frequencies, w_line, h_metal, h_sub, eps_sub, l_stub, l_feed):
    # simulation parameters
    nres = 16
    dx = w_line / 4  # desired resolution across strip
    shutoff = 1e-2
    tmax = 1000  # max time [periods]
    PML_decay = [0.01,.1,.1]
    courant = 0.9
    shot_every =.5 # movie [periods]

    # margins
    margin = 3 * h_sub
    port_margin = 2 * h_sub
    source_offset = 3 * h_sub

    # ground plane as PEC boundary on z-
    boundaries = ["PML", "PML", ("PEC", "PML")]

    # vertical dims
    zmargin = 3 * h_sub
    zmin = -h_sub
    zmax = h_metal + zmargin

    views = [
        lumi.view("Ez", x=-source_offset, y=0, z=-h_sub / 2),
        lumi.view("Hz", z=h_metal / 2),
    ]

    # materials
    # refine mesh in metal: n sets mesh density relative to vacuum
    n = (c0 / frequency / nres) / dx
    materials = {
        "air": lumi.material(1),
        "sub": lumi.material(epsilon=eps_sub),
        "PEC": lumi.PEC_material(n),
    }
    background = "air"

    # layers
    TRACE = 1, 0
    SUB = 10, 0
    layer_stack = LayerStack(
        layers={
            "trace": LayerLevel(
                layer=LogicalLayer(layer=TRACE),
                thickness=h_metal,
                zmin=0,
                material="PEC",
                mesh_order=10,
            ),
            "sub": LayerLevel(
                layer=LogicalLayer(layer=SUB),

                material="sub",

    stub = c << lumi.straight(length=l_stub, width=w_line, layer=TRACE)

    stub.movex(l_feed / 2)

    s = c << lumi.straight(length=source_offset, width=w_line, layer=TRACE)

            f=frequency,
            bandwidth=max(max(frequencies) - min(frequencies), frequency / 8),
        )

        lumi.gf_monitor("o1", c, layer_stack, frame="line_mode"),
        lumi.gf_monitor("o2", c, layer_stack, frame="line_mode"),
